title: Acceleration magnitude a1
description: Essential: Correctly calculates a1 = 2 m/s² using v = a1 * t with v=30 m/s, t=15 s.

title: Acceleration magnitude a2
description: Essential: Correctly calculates a2 = 5 m/s² using v² = 2 * a2 * x with v=30 m/s, x=90 m.

title: Correct kinematic equation selection
description: Important: Uses v = a1*t for acceleration phase and v² = 2*a2*x for braking phase, recognizing uniform acceleration.

title: Sign convention consistency
description: Important: Recognizes that a2 is a deceleration (negative acceleration) but reports magnitude as positive.

title: Unit analysis
description: Optional: Includes units in calculations and verifies final units are m/s².

title: Incorrect equation mixing
description: Pitfall: Uses v = a*t for braking phase instead of v² = 2*a*x, leading to wrong a2.

title: Sign error in braking
description: Pitfall: Forgets that braking acceleration opposes motion, leading to positive a2 value without magnitude interpretation.
